auto_clone.description: Materialize and synchronize this linked repository automatically before each agent launch.

name.description: Stable alias used in prompts, metadata, and SASE_LINKED_REPO_<NAME>_DIR env vars.

path.description: Primary checkout path. Relative paths are resolved from the project's primary WORKSPACE_DIR.

description.description: Human-readable purpose used when generating agent memory for this linked repository.

sidecarRepo.description: One sidecar repository, keyed by its role name under repos.sidecar.builtin or repos.sidecar.custom.

auto_clone.description: Materialize and synchronize this sidecar automatically before each agent launch. The intrinsic agents role ignores this setting and is never exposed to launched agents or cloned into workspaces.

auto_sync.description: Opt this role's materialized primary sidecar clone into conservative background convergence: fetch and fast-forward only while clean, attached, and non-diverged. Independent of auto_clone. The intrinsic agents role ignores this setting.

description.description: Human-readable purpose used in repository inventory and generated agent memory.

disabled.description: Disable this sidecar entry and suppress matching implicit sidecar defaults, including the managed-project agents sidecar.

ref.description: Optional contextual ref renderer and document filter policy for this sidecar role.

repo.description: Optional owner/repo or bare repository slug. Omit to derive <project>--<role> in the project's organization.

visibility.description: Visibility used when creating a missing sidecar repository. Set the managed-project agents role to private to override its public default.

kind.description: Artifact reference kind, for inline specs or provider overrides.

identity.description: Optional identity property for this document kind.

inventory.description: Document inventory policy for completion and resolution.

publication.description: Publication and back-link behavior for this document kind.

path_globs.description: Repo-relative document path globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Omit for the Markdown default; an empty list allows no paths.

axeEnv.description: Environment values as literals or late-bound secret references.

enabled.description: Soft-disable this chop without deleting its keyed configuration

timeout.description: Per-chop timeout duration overriding the lumberjack chop_timeout

inhibit_if.description: Patch, agent-hood, agent-clan, or agent-runners guards evaluated before the script

for_each.description: Literal targets or a named target source expanded into stable chop instances

vars.description: Arbitrary non-secret values copied into the chop context; builtin refresh_docs accepts prompt and polish_prompt string overrides

use.description: Installed file-hook provider id to use as the base template, qualified as <plugin>@<id> ('builtin' or an installed distribution name).

name.description: Unique lowercase slug shown in notifications and file-hook listings.

description.description: Optional human-readable purpose for the hook.

command.description: Shell command whose final argument is the matched file path.

filters.description: Optional event-selection criteria; omitted or empty means unrestricted outside project-local auto-scoping.

projects.description: Optional user-facing project names; omitted means every project.

sidecars.description: Optional sidecar role names; omitted means any repository.

path_globs.description: Optional repo-relative path globs, including !-prefixed exclusions.

agent_name_globs.description: Optional SASE agent-name globs matched against the agent that produced the event, including !-prefixed exclusions.

ops.description: Optional file operations; omitted means all operations.

causes.description: Optional non-user event causes this hook accepts in addition to user commits.

taskTypeConfigEntry.description: One bead.task_types entry: either 'use' (override an installed task type's spec) or a full new task-type spec.

use.description: Installed task type id to use as the base spec, qualified as <plugin>@<id> ('builtin' or an installed distribution name). Sibling keys deep-merge over the referenced spec.

schema_version.description: Task-type spec wire schema version; currently always 1.

task_type.description: Immutable snake_case slug identifying this task type.

summary.description: One-line summary inlined into every agent's Tier 1 context.

when_to_use.description: Agent-facing guidance on when to file this task type, inlined into every agent's Tier 1 context.

glyph.description: Optional single-terminal-cell glyph shown in chips and CLI cells.

accent_color.description: Optional #RRGGBB accent color; a type without one is assigned a stable hash-derived color.

agent_creatable.description: Whether agents may file this task type through 'sase bead create'.

default_size.description: Optional default --size for this task type; unset keeps sizing an intentional choice.

fields.description: Declared field values this task type accepts.

body_template.description: Optional Jinja2 template rendered below the bead description from field values with the 'template' role.

min_plus_ones.description: Per-type +1 corroboration bar; 0 (the spec default) gates every ready task bead of this type.

name.description: Snake_case field name, referenced by body_template placeholders.

role.description: Non-empty subset of {data, template}; defaults to both.

max_length.description: Maximum character length; string fields only.

values.description: Allowed values; required and non-empty for enum fields.

externalMirrorIssueFilters.description: Selection criteria for external_mirror.issues; an issue must pass every configured criterion to be mirrored into a bead. An empty criterion accepts everything; *_globs entries may be !-prefixed to exclude. Setting a criterion replaces the shipped defaults for that criterion rather than appending to them.

author_globs.description: Issue author globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Empty (the default) accepts every author.

label_globs.description: Issue label globs, including !-prefixed exclusions, matched against every label on the issue. Empty (the default) accepts every label set.

title_globs.description: Issue title globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Empty (the default) accepts every title.

states.description: Issue states accepted for mirroring. Empty (the default) accepts every state.

externalMirrorPullRequestFilters.description: Selection criteria for external_mirror.pull_requests; a remote pull request must pass every configured criterion to be adopted as a Patch. An empty criterion accepts everything; *_globs entries may be !-prefixed to exclude. Setting a criterion replaces the shipped defaults for that criterion rather than appending to them.

author_globs.description: Remote PR author globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Empty (the default) accepts every author.

base_ref_globs.description: Remote PR base-ref globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Empty (the default) accepts every base ref.

head_ref_globs.description: Remote PR head-ref globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Ships with release-please and release-plz head-ref exclusions so those PRs are not adopted as Patches by default.

title_globs.description: Remote PR title globs, including !-prefixed exclusions. Empty (the default) accepts every title.

states.description: Remote PR states accepted for adoption. Empty (the default) accepts every state.

glossaryEntry.description: One project-local glossary entry keyed by its canonical displayed term.

definition.description: Nonblank Markdown definition for the canonical term.

aliases.description: Additional single-line aliases matched after the canonical term. Plurals are derived automatically and need not be listed.

xpromptInputDefinitions.description: Input argument definitions (array or object shorthand)

name.description: The argument name (used for named args like name=value)

type.description: The expected type of the argument value

default.description: Default value if argument is not provided

oneOf.description: Object shorthand: { argName: type } or { argName: { type, default, description } }
Full definition with type, default, and description

default.description: Default value if argument is not provided

path.description: Absolute or ~/ rooted local path that bounds @file references.

h1_title.description: Optional H1 title used by generated AMD-managed AGENTS.md. SASE-managed projects derive a stable project title when this is null.

glossary.description: Project-local domain glossary. Valid only in a project's canonical sase/sase.yml; user, overlay, plugin, and builtin layers are diagnosed by the Rust config backend.

agents_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for AMD-managed AGENTS.md files.

agents_minimal_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for create-if-missing minimal AGENTS.md files.

sase_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for generated sase/memory/sase.md files.

readme_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for generated sase/memory/README.md files.

amd_agents_template.description: Deprecated top-level alias for memory.agents_template. Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for AMD-managed AGENTS.md files. New configuration must use memory.agents_template.

memory_sase_template.description: Deprecated top-level alias for memory.sase_template. Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for generated sase/memory/sase.md files. New configuration must use memory.sase_template.

is_sase_managed.description: Explicitly authorize SASE to manage repository resources, including project memory, root AGENTS.md, and SDD initialization. Only the target repository's own sase/sase.yml is consulted.

id.description: Explicit owner identity. This object is authoritative only in the machine overlay selected by ~/.sase/machine_name; run sase config init to create or repair it.

username.description: Stable, globally unique SASE username shared by all machines owned by the same user; normally the user's GitHub username.

machine_name.description: Stable name unique among this user's machines. In a selected machine overlay it must match the ~/.sase/machine_name selector.
Deprecated migration input for legacy machine overlays. Run sase config init to move it to id.machine_name; new configuration must use the nested identity object.

repro_output_dir.description: Directory where ACE agent repro captures are written. Empty string uses the runtime default.

axe_description_expanded.description: Whether AXE descriptions start expanded; the configured toggle key changes this only for the current ACE session.

relations_expanded.description: Whether the Artifacts relation panel starts expanded; the configured toggle key changes this only for the current ACE session.

stitches.description: Settings for the Artifacts Stitches pane

default_query.description: Canonical query loaded into the persistent Stitches filter when ACE starts. One singular, non-negatable project: token may use a configured project name, ProjectSpec directory key, or alias; known committed refs are rewritten to the configured name. Otherwise startup adds an explicit ACE-query project or the current registered project when available. After startup, no project: token means all projects. Merge visibility accepts merges:hide, merges:show, or merges:only. Origin accepts origin:stitch, origin:auto, or origin:manual, repeatable and negatable like repo: and author:. Queries without an explicit positive limit:N are uncapped. Relative date windows re-anchor on refresh; configuration changes take effect in the next ACE process.

commits.description: Deprecated alias for artifacts.stitches. New configuration must use artifacts.stitches.

snippets.description: Snippet expansions for the prompt input (trigger string to expansion text)

snippet_config_path.description: Config file that receives new ace.snippets entries written from the prompt bar. Empty string uses the user's sase.yml (the chezmoi source when chezmoi is enabled). A relative path resolves against ~/.config/sase/. The suffix must be .yml or .yaml, and the file must be writable; an unusable configured value falls back to the default and reports why.

tribes.description: Per-tribe ACE TUI identity display settings, keyed by bare tribe name. Every configured tribe must carry a description.

icon.description: Short glyph shown before the tribe name on identity surfaces that include an icon; an empty string disables an inherited icon

color.description: RGB foreground for structured tribe icons and names throughout the ACE TUI, without recoloring semantic chrome; an empty string uses the ACE fallback

initially_expanded.description: Whether the Agents-tab tribe panel starts expanded each time the panel comes into existence

description.description: One-line explanation of what this tribe is for, shown in the ACE Agents-tab metadata panel when the tribe panel is selected. Required for every configured tribe.

notification_tabs.description: Per-tab notification indicator styling, keyed by notification-panel tab key: the synthetic "hitl", "errors", "general", "snoozed", and "muted" tabs, a gate-declared panel name, or a notification tag.

color.description: RGB foreground for this tab's count chip in the top-bar notification indicator and its tooltip label; an empty string restores the built-in default for that tab

icon.description: Single emoji or glyph rendered for this tab in the notification panel's tab strip and the top-bar indicator chip; an empty string restores the built-in default for that tab

notification_indicator_max_counts.description: Maximum per-tab counts rendered in the top-bar notification indicator before the remainder collapses into a single dim "+N" chip

tool_calls.description: Tool-call presentation settings for the ACE TUI

slow_threshold_seconds.description: Minimum tool-call duration, in seconds, shown as slow in ACE metadata and timelines

video.description: mpv-backed terminal video artifact-file playback settings

vo.description: mpv video output driver for terminal video playback

extra_mpv_args.description: Additional mpv arguments appended after SASE defaults

updates.description: Automatic ACE-session update-check behavior for SASE, plugins, supported agent CLIs, the Updates tab, badge, and toasts

startup_toast.description: Show an informational toast on ACE startup when SASE core, installed plugins, or supported agent CLIs have updates available

post_update_toast.description: Show a one-shot confirmation toast after a comprehensive update changes SASE code and restarts ACE into the new version

indicator.description: Show a segmented top-bar badge while SASE core, installed plugins, or supported agent CLIs have updates available

prebuild_rust.description: Prebuild matching editable sase-core Rust artifacts in a background cache when ACE observes a safe core update; confirmed updates fall back to the normal Rust build on every miss

check_interval_minutes.description: Interval between update-check attempts in a running ACE session. Ordinary attempts only revalidate the cached composite snapshot; in-flight guards may suppress overlapping work.

check_ttl_minutes.description: Minimum age before a cached update status is refreshed during automatic ACE-session checks. This cache TTL is separate from the configured session check cadence and takes precedence over check_ttl_hours when both are set.

check_ttl_hours.description: Legacy/deprecated cache TTL for automatic ACE-session update checks. Prefer check_ttl_minutes, which overrides this when both are set.

recompute_interval_minutes.description: Minimum snapshot age before a periodic ACE-session check may perform a full network recompute across SASE, plugins, and supported agent CLIs. Checks between full recomputes only revalidate cached candidates locally.

incoming_commits.description: Incoming commit previews shown on the ACE Updates tab for SASE core and installed plugin updates

default_effort.description: Default reasoning-effort level applied to agent launches when a prompt does not request one via %effort or a %model:<model>@<effort> suffix. Leave empty for no override (let each provider use its own default). A configured level is best-effort: providers that cannot honor it skip it with a warning.

default_model.description: Model expression used when a prompt has no %model directive. Values use the same grammar as %model and may reference built-in size aliases such as @large.

epic_lander_model.description: Model expression used for epic land agents unless the plan sets an explicit land model.

big_epic_lander_model.description: Model expression used for threshold-selected big epic land agents unless the plan sets an explicit land model.

model_alias_history_limit.description: Maximum runs shown per alias in the Launch Control agent-history panel.

model_tier_map.description: Mapping from model tiers to specific model identifiers

model_aliases.description: Model alias configuration. builtin contains overrides for SASE's five size aliases; custom contains user-defined aliases with required descriptions.

builtin.description: Overrides for SASE's built-in size aliases: xsmall, small, medium, large, and xlarge. See src/sase/llm_provider/model_alias_defaults.yml for the current shipped default of each alias. Values are bare known models, explicit provider/model targets, nested provider-local model paths, or '@<alias>' references; a reference may carry a trailing '@<effort>' that overrides the referenced alias's effort. Single-pipe values (A | B) form load-balanced round-robin pools; double-pipe values (A || B) form ordered provider-availability fallbacks. Operators cannot be mixed, and every member uses the same grammar and may carry a trailing @<effort>.

custom.description: User-defined custom model aliases usable from %model:@<alias> / %m:@<alias>. Each custom alias must include both the target model and a short description shown in completions and Launch Control.

model.description: Model target using a bare model, provider/model, nested provider-local path, or @<alias>. Single-pipe values (A | B) form load-balanced round-robin pools; double-pipe values (A || B) form ordered provider-availability fallbacks. Operators cannot be mixed, and every member uses the same grammar and may carry a trailing @<effort>.

bucket.description: Optional display-only bucket in the ACE Launch Control; alias resolution remains flat and unchanged.

buckets.description: Optional display-only Launch Control bucket metadata for buckets referenced by custom aliases.

retry.description: Per-provider retry configuration. Keys are provider names (e.g., 'agy', 'claude', 'codex').

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries on matching errors

error_patterns.description: Substrings to match against error output (case-insensitive)

wait_times.description: Wait times in seconds for each retry attempt. Last value is reused if retries exceed list length.

fallback_model.description: Model to fall back to after all retries are exhausted

continuation_prompt.description: Prompt prefix applied when continuing after a retry

preserve_workspace.description: Preserve the existing workspace when retrying

spawn_new_agent.description: Retry in a fresh detached agent process

usage_limit.description: Usage-limit detection and automatic provider disable configuration. Unlike 'retry', this section has genuine global scalars (enabled, disable_seconds, min/max_disable_seconds, honor_reset_hint, notify) alongside per-provider pattern overrides nested under 'providers', because every provider's disable duration and reset-hint handling share the same defaults unless overridden.

enabled.description: Enable automatic provider disable on detected usage-limit errors.

disable_seconds.description: Fallback disable duration in seconds used when no reset hint is available or honored.

min_disable_seconds.description: Minimum disable duration in seconds; clamps any duration derived from a parsed reset hint.

max_disable_seconds.description: Maximum disable duration in seconds; clamps any duration derived from a parsed reset hint.

honor_reset_hint.description: Prefer a reset time reported by the provider itself over the flat disable_seconds fallback. Parses a bare or zoned clock time ('resets at 8pm', 'resets 6:38pm (America/New_York)'), an absolute date ('try again at Aug 20th, 2026 6:38 AM', 'resets Aug 20, 6:38 am (America/New_York)', 'resets 2026-08-20 06:38 UTC'), or a relative duration ('try again in 2 hours').

notify.description: Send a notification when a provider is automatically disabled.

providers.description: Per-provider usage-limit overrides. Keys are provider names (e.g., 'agy', 'claude', 'codex').

patterns.description: Substrings to match against error output (case- and apostrophe-insensitive). Added to the built-in patterns unless replace_patterns is true.

exclude_patterns.description: Substrings that, when present anywhere in the error output, prevent a match even if a pattern also matches. Always additive to the built-ins.

disable_seconds.description: Per-provider override for the fallback disable duration. Null falls back to the global disable_seconds.

honor_reset_hint.description: Per-provider override for honoring the provider's own reset hint. Null falls back to the global honor_reset_hint.

replace_patterns.description: When true, 'patterns' replaces the built-in patterns entirely instead of extending them.

vcs_provider.description: Configuration for the VCS provider abstraction layer

provider.description: Name of the VCS provider ('git', 'hg', or 'auto' for auto-detection)

default_hooks.description: Override the default required hooks added to new Patches. Each entry is a hook command string (supports '!' and '$' prefixes).

workspace_root.description: Root directory for workspaces. Overridden by SASE_WORKSPACE_ROOT env var. Defaults to $HOME/workspace for git.

pr_tags.description: Key-value tags appended as TAG=VALUE lines to PR commit messages

use_project_pr_prefix.description: Prepend [<project>] to PR titles or PR descriptions.

vcs_repo_completion.description: Repository-name completion inside VCS workflow refs such as #gh:owner/.

enabled.description: Enable repository completion inside VCS workflow refs.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds before cached repository lists are refreshed.

max_repos.description: Maximum repositories requested from providers and returned to completion callers.

vcs_ref_completion.description: Project, Patch, and namespace completion at the root of VCS workflow refs such as #gh:.

enabled.description: Enable completion at the root of VCS workflow refs.
Run the commit finalizer after SASE-launched agent turns.

max_passes.description: Maximum follow-up turns the finalizer may run before failing a still-dirty workspace.

require_conventional_subject.description: Reject SASE commit messages whose subject line is not a Conventional Commit.

allowed_types.description: Commit types accepted by the Conventional Commit subject validator. A configured list replaces the built-in set.

github_orgs.description: GitHub organization/user names the user has push access to, used for cloning and PR submission

default_linked_repos.description: Inject the default plans and beads sidecar repositories plus the intrinsically hidden agents sidecar repository for SASE-managed projects.

repos.description: Repositories related to the current project.

linked.description: Related repositories exposed to launched agents as workspace-matched directories.

sidecar.description: Project-owned sidecar repositories keyed by role name. Reserved roles (plans, beads, agents) belong under builtin; every other role is a document sidecar and belongs under custom. Ordinary roles clone below sase/repos/<role>; the hidden agents role is explicitly accessible only at ~/.sase/projects/<project_key>/repos/agents.

builtin.description: Overrides for the reserved sidecar roles. Keys are role names and must be one of plans, beads, or agents.

custom.description: User-declared document sidecars such as research. Keys are role names and must not name a reserved role (plans, beads, agents).

linked_repos.description: Deprecated alias for 'repos.linked'. Still parsed during the compatibility window; prefer 'repos.linked' in new config.

sibling_repos.description: Deprecated alias for 'repos.linked'. Still parsed during the compatibility window; prefer 'repos.linked' in new config.

bead_refresh.description: Remote freshness policy for bead commands using sidecar stores

push_after_commit.description: Controls git push after SDD commits in separate_repo storage. true pushes synchronously, false skips push, and async starts a detached background push.

repo.description: Sidecar SDD repository options for providers that support separate_repo storage

name.description: Optional sidecar SDD repo override. Accepts a repo name or owner/repo; empty uses the provider convention.

big_epic_phase_threshold.description: Minimum authored phase count that selects llm_provider.big_epic_lander_model for an epic without an explicit land model.

task_triage.description: Volume controls for task-bead triage gates: the +1 bar a ready task bead needs before it earns a TaskTriage gate, and the staleness sweep for the sub-threshold remainder.

min_plus_ones.description: +1 reports a ready task bead needs before bead_task_triage raises its TaskTriage gate. Applies to untyped legacy beads and to task types that declare no triage.min_plus_ones of their own; a typed bead's own bar always takes precedence. 0 restores the pre-threshold behavior of gating every such ready task bead.

stale_after_days.description: Days after creation at which a still-sub-threshold ready task bead is considered stale and eligible for the cleanup gate.

stale_cleanup_min_beads.description: Stale beads required before bead_stale_cleanup raises its gate. Below this count the chop does nothing.

epic_resume.description: Volume controls for the epic_resume chop, which raises an EpicResume gate when a failed phase agent stalls an epic. Off by default; enable via the epic_resume_gate feature flag.

settle_seconds.description: Seconds the newest clan-member failure must sit before the epic_resume chop treats the epic as stalled. Guards against gating on a handoff race or a fast retry.

push_after_commit.description: When true, run `git push` after `sase bead work` commits sdd/beads/issues.jsonl. Push failures only warn; the local commit is preserved.

task_types.description: Project-declared task-type catalog entries: an override of an installed task type (via 'use') or a brand-new project-local task type.

external_mirror.description: Configuration for the external tracker mirror (issues into beads, pull requests into Patches).

issues.description: Configuration for mirroring tracker issues into beads.

pull_requests.description: Configuration for adopting remote pull requests as Patches.

exclude_labels.description: Deprecated alias for external_mirror.issues.filters.label_globs; folds in as negated globs when label_globs is empty. Tracker labels whose issues are never mirrored into beads.

pr_authors.description: Deprecated alias for external_mirror.pull_requests.filters.author_globs; folds in as plain (non-negated) globs when author_globs is empty. Remote PR authors whose pull requests are adopted as Patches.

workspace.description: Workspace directory layout policy (Phase 1+: sase-3p WorkspaceStore).

root.description: Workspace root policy: 'xdg-state' (default platform state directory), 'adjacent' (legacy opt-in `primary_<num>/` layout), or an absolute path. The `SASE_WORKSPACE_ROOT` environment variable overrides this when set.

project_key.description: Explicit override for the project_key used to namespace managed workspaces. Empty string means derive from the single Git remote (preferred) or the primary path plus a short hash.

cleanup_ttl_days.description: Days before unclaimed managed workspaces are eligible for `sase workspace cleanup --stale`.

xprompt_aliases.description: Aliases for xprompt references, substituted before any other xprompt processing (e.g., {"#gh_sase": "#gh:sase"})

commit_hooks.description: Commands to run before VCS dispatch and after a commit-producing dispatch succeeds.

before.description: Command to run before commit dispatch (e.g., 'just fix'). Empty string means disabled.

after.description: Command to run after a commit is created and, where applicable, pushed. Empty string means disabled.

file_hooks.description: Non-gating commands matched to repository file events.

plugins.description: Project-declared plugin dependencies. A linked or sidecar checkout is not an install; each entry is checked against distributions in the running environment.

required.description: PEP 508 requirement strings that must be installed. Every non-builtin <plugin>@ prefix used anywhere in this project config must name a distribution listed here.

max_running_agents.description: Maximum number of slot-participating user agents that may be running concurrently across all projects: top-level user agents and eligible parallel family members; serial follow-ups, workflow Python/bash steps, and axe runners are excluded.

max_agent_pipe_chain.description: Maximum number of sase pipe hops in one family chain. The original agent is depth 0; each successful pipe increments depth by one and is refused when the next link would exceed this bound.

deference_seconds_per_step.description: Seconds a waiter defers per priority step above the default priority of 10.

deference_max_seconds.description: Maximum continuous-eligibility delay for a waiter with priority above the default.

history_limit.description: Maximum number of finished procs kept in ~/.sase/procs. Running procs are never pruned. Lower values trim history sooner; the oldest finished procs (and their logs) are removed first.

tasks.description: Deprecated alias for 'procs'. Still parsed during the compatibility window; prefer 'procs' in new config.

markdown.description: Markdown prose formatting policy for SASE-generated Markdown.

print_width.description: Column width SASE wraps generated Markdown prose at: plan files, bead notes and pages, memory shims, generated skills, prompt archives, and the default --wrap for 'sase bead show' and 'sase plan show'. The prettier CLI cannot read this value, so repos whose Markdown SASE writes into need their own prettier config to match.

max_stored_per_agent.description: Maximum number of automatic artifact captures whose bytes are copied per agent run. Version-control-backed references are not counted and are not capped.

max_history_scan.description: Maximum number of durable commits searched per file for an exact version-control-backed artifact revision.

max_file_size_bytes.description: Maximum size of one file copied into the workspace-local prompt-artifact pool. Larger files are still hashed and recorded.

pool_max_bytes.description: Maximum workspace-local prompt-artifact pool size before opportunistic garbage collection.

enabled.description: Enable automatic artifact retention after agent finalization. When disabled, retention removes nothing.

keep_per_label.description: Number of newest automatic captures kept per label. Set to 0 to disable generation-based retention.

max_age_days.description: Trash automatic captures older than this many days. Set to 0 to disable age-based retention.

trash_grace_days.description: Number of days artifact trash remains restorable before purge removes expired entries.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name governing all SASE wall-clock display and timestamp generation (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'US/Pacific'). Defaults to the system timezone when unset.

use_chezmoi.description: Remap home xprompt paths to chezmoi-managed equivalents under ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/

xprompts.description: Reusable text templates that can be referenced in prompts

tags.description: Semantic role tags for tag-based xprompt lookup

snippet.description: Opt-in snippet expansion: true for auto trigger word, or a custom trigger string

skill.description: Skill deployment metadata for generated skills

log_skill_use.description: Whether the generated skill includes the first-step audit directive that records its own use (default true)

flush_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between local telemetry store flushes in long-lived processes

retention.description: Retention windows for raw and rolled-up metric samples

raw_seconds.description: Seconds to retain raw metric samples

rollup_5m_seconds.description: Seconds to retain five-minute metric rollups

rollup_1h_seconds.description: Seconds to retain hourly metric rollups

prometheus.description: Deprecated legacy settings accepted for compatibility and ignored

exposition_port.description: Port for the Prometheus metrics exposition endpoint

health_thresholds.description: Thresholds for the telemetry health traffic-light check

error_rate_warn.description: Error rate percentage to trigger a warning

error_rate_critical.description: Error rate percentage to trigger a critical alert

retry_rate_warn.description: Retry rate percentage to trigger a warning

retry_rate_critical.description: Retry rate percentage to trigger a critical alert

p95_latency_warn.description: P95 latency in seconds to trigger a warning

p95_latency_critical.description: P95 latency in seconds to trigger a critical alert

feature_flags.description: Code-owned SASE feature flags keyed by flag name.

coder_inherits_planner_chat.description: Opt-in beta: the follow-up coder inherits the planner's chat via #fork instead of starting from the approved plan file alone.

completion_refresh_on_update.description: After a successful sase update, regenerate, zcompile, and restamp installed shell completion scripts. Off by default while the generator soaks.

epic_resume_gate.description: Opt-in beta: the epic_resume chop raises an EpicResume gate when a failed phase agent stalls an epic.

prettier_enabled.description: Format markdown with prettier when it is installed. SASE_DISABLE_PRETTIER remains a deprecated alias.
